name: 폭염
description: Burning Brand — a ring of fire brands each of MY units, then a small burning card flies from each unit into my hand where two golden flame cards appear and fold into the hand (literal draw 2)
format: WebP sprite strip (lossy RGB + alpha), straight (non-premultiplied) alpha
card: 아군 전체 피해 2 / 드로우2 (spell.type draw_ex, ownAllHp:2, draw:2)
playModeNote: NEW MODE perUnit+flow (3 layers). 1) unitImpact on every unit of the CASTER's board (aoe_ally), each at its own delay. 2) flow: one small projectile per unit, from that unit's centre to the caster's hand, starting at flow.startMs + that unit's delay. 3) arrival: one strip at the hand when the flows land. If the caster has no units, launch 2 flows (draw 2) from the caster's board centre instead. For the AI caster, use the opponent board and point 'to' at #oppHand (or the opp deck).

unitImpact.anchor: each unit centre on the caster's board

delay.note: delayMs = 0.1*|unitX - stageCentreX| (0-50ms ripple); using full distance from centre (existing unitDelayMs) is also fine

flow.from: each unit centre (same units as unitImpact), offsetYPx@1080p -20
flow.note: head arrives at the 'to' point; fade in 60ms, fade out over the last 50ms (same as playProjectile)

sfx.source: fs2 C-style: synth low brown-noise rumble with rising low-pass (slow amplitude sway) + soft pitch-drop sub thump(s), layered with this concept's own Kling clip audio low-passed ~0.6-0.65 kHz; final low-pass 1.7/2 kHz
sfx.note: scorch hit at 60ms, soft low landing thump when the flows reach the hand (~620ms)

sequence: after the centre card: scorch on my units 0-550ms (delays 0-50) · flows 330-660ms · arrival at hand 590-990ms · sound from 0ms
